agent_assessment: All four bugs from the plan are implemented and verified. Bug 1: agentactivity.Service now has a GetRunDiff method (line 120) that delegates to the inner differ, and the execution.NewService type assertion (service.go:247) correctly wires it. Bug 2: mapRunStatus (polling.go:250) resets ConsecutiveUnknown on known statuses and fails after maxConsecutiveUnknown (default 5) consecutive unknowns. Bug 3: refreshRunningLocked tracks ConsecutiveErrors (polling.go:141) with threshold of 30 and max-age timeout of 30 minutes (polling.go:120), both configurable via ServiceConfig. Bug 4: SelfScenarioName is explicitly set to "swarm-manager" in routes_execution.go:26. All 6 planned test functions exist in polling_test.go and cover the critical paths. go build and go test both pass cleanly across the entire swarm-manager API.
notes: Non-sandbox execution: diff shows 0 changed files, but all implementation verified by direct code inspection
All configurable thresholds have sensible defaults: 30 consecutive errors, 5 consecutive unknowns, 30 min max-age
runTracker map is correctly ephemeral (in-memory only, created/deleted in sync with execution records)

evidence.title: Bug 1: agentactivity.Service implements RunDiffer
evidence.description: agentactivity/service.go:120-125 adds GetRunDiff method that delegates to s.differ (the inner agentmanager client). execution/service.go:247 performs type assertion cfg.AgentService.(RunDiffer) which now succeeds because agentactivity.Service has the method. TestNewService_DifferWired (polling_test.go:121) confirms differ is non-nil when AgentService implements RunDiffer.

evidence.title: Bug 2: mapRunStatus handles unknown statuses with grace period
evidence.description: polling.go:250-285 — mapRunStatus default case increments tracker.ConsecutiveUnknown, logs warning on first unknown, returns StatusRunning during grace period, and returns StatusFailed after maxConsecutiveUnknown (default 5) consecutive unknowns. All known statuses (pending, starting, running, needs_review, complete, failed, cancelled) reset ConsecutiveUnknown to 0. TestMapRunStatus_AllKnown and TestMapRunStatus_Unknown_GracePeriod verify this behavior.

evidence.title: Bug 3: Staleness detection via consecutive errors and max-age
evidence.description: polling.go:139-159 — GetRunState errors increment tracker.ConsecutiveErrors; after maxConsecutiveErrors (default 30, ~60s), run is marked StatusFailed with reason 'lost contact with agent-manager run'. polling.go:120-137 — max-age check fails runs exceeding maxRunAge (default 30 min). Successful polls reset ConsecutiveErrors to 0 (line 161). ServiceConfig fields MaxConsecutiveErrors, MaxConsecutiveUnknown, MaxRunAge are all configurable. TestPolling_ConsecutiveErrors, TestPolling_MaxAge, and TestPolling_ErrorReset all verify these paths.

evidence.title: Bug 4: SelfScenarioName explicitly set
evidence.description: routes_execution.go:26 sets SelfScenarioName: "swarm-manager" in the ServiceConfig, removing the fragile filepath.Base(rootDir) fallback dependency.
